# Racklion

> Cloud cost advisory and GPU capacity sourcing. Racklion helps teams reduce cloud waste, evaluate reservations, and source GPUs, servers, power, colocation and data-center space. Cloud and GPUs can be part of the same infrastructure plan.

## What Racklion does
- Cloud economics: review utilization, commitments, egress and idle resources to identify savings that can support GPU workloads.
- On-prem readiness, hybrid architecture, and resilience planning.
- Sourcing: GPU capacity (B300 / B200 / H200 / H100), colocation, power, and data-center space.

## Key pages
- Source capacity: https://www.racklion.com/source
- Consulting: https://www.racklion.com/consulting
- FAQ: https://www.racklion.com/faq
- Daily On-Prem Signal (infrastructure news): https://www.racklion.com/signals
- About: https://www.racklion.com/about

- GPU pricing: https://www.racklion.com/ — Dated public GPU-hour price comparisons for B300, B200, H200, H100, A100, and L40S, with an illustrative reserved-capacity savings calculator.
